hero.label: Whiteout Survival Tracker
hero.title: Track every chief. Plan every upgrade.
hero.description: A free companion for Whiteout Survival. Keep your buildings, heroes, gear and research in one place, plan the next upgrade, and run your Core events from the first day to the history.
hero.note: Free. Your data stays in this browser.

continue.title: Continue with {name}

how.label: How it works
how.title: From your first chief to event history in four steps

create.title: Create a chief
create.description: Give it a name. The server number and notes are optional.

levels.title: Set your levels
levels.description: Enter your Furnace and building levels, then fill in heroes, gear and research as you go.

plan.title: Plan upgrades
plan.description: See the resources, time and power for your goals, and what is still missing.

events.title: Run your events
events.description: Count points, log scores and ranks, then save the event to History.

features.label: What you can do
features.title: Plan it, play it, then look back at it

plan.title: Plan any upgrade
plan.description: Set a goal in a Plan flyout on Buildings, Heroes, Chief Gear and Research. See the resources, time and power it needs, with speedups and bonuses read from your Bonuses page.

coreEvents.title: Core event calculators
coreEvents.description: SvS, Alliance Showdown, King of Icefield and Hall of Chief. Count points for each action, add your expert bonuses, and check thresholds and rank rewards.

eventLog.title: Event log and daily checklist
eventLog.description: Log score and rank for each day of an event. A checklist lists the actions you can do each day.

history.title: History: plan against actual
history.description: End an event to save it. Compare your plan with what you did, and see each planned upgrade as done or not done.

research.title: Research trees
research.description: Growth, Economy, Battle, War Academy and the T12 tabs, as a grid or a tree, with unlocks by server age.

alliance.title: Alliance tech and maps
alliance.description: Track your alliance banner, tech and facilities, and read the layout of the castle, strongholds and fortresses.

numbers.title: What the tracker covers
numbers.wiki: wiki reference pages, plus a timeline

pages.label: Every page
pages.title: Grouped the way the game is
pages.description: The same pages as the sidebar inside the app.

privacy.label: Your data
privacy.title: Private by default, portable when you want it

browser.title: Stays in your browser
browser.description: There is no account to make. Your chiefs are saved in this browser on this device.

file.title: One saved file
file.description: Everything you enter is kept in a single saved file in the browser, so it loads fast and nothing is split across places.

chiefs.title: Several chiefs
chiefs.description: Keep a main and your alts. Switch between them from the sidebar.

backup.title: Backup and restore
backup.description: Export your data to a file from Settings and import it on another browser or device.

free.question: Is it free?
free.answer: Yes. There is nothing to pay for and nothing to unlock.

data.question: Where is my data?
data.answer: In this browser, in local storage for this site. It is not sent to a server. If you clear the site data for this page, the chiefs are removed, so export a backup first.

move.question: How do I move to another device?
move.answer: Open Settings, then Backup and data, and export a backup file. On the other device, open the same page, go to Settings, Backup and data, and import that file.

chiefs.question: Can I have several chiefs?
chiefs.answer: Yes. There is no limit. Each chief has its own buildings, heroes, research and events, and you switch between them in the sidebar.

account.question: Do I need an account or a save file from the game?
account.answer: No. You type in your levels yourself. The game data for costs, times and stats comes with the tracker.

official.question: Is this an official app?
official.answer: No. It is an unofficial fan tool. It is not affiliated with Whiteout Survival or Century Games. The footer has the full notice.

wiki.question: What is the Wiki?
wiki.answer: A set of reference pages for the game data, such as buildings, heroes, pets, items and events, plus a server timeline. You can read it without creating a chief.

closing.title: Start tracking today
closing.description: Your first chief takes one name. You can change everything later.
